prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE original battle-ready enemy sprite illustration for an industrial fantasy action RPG, M26 Severed-Wire Shearwing from a powerless underground hangar. A small hovering wire-cutting machine with exactly TWO large rotating scissor blade wings like an open SWALLOWTAIL, mounted around a very THIN central spindle. Distinct broad swept-back V silhouette, two long curved tapering blades with shear edges facing each other, root pivots exposed so the wings can close together to intercept a limited number of bullets. Central axial motor is narrow and compact, no bulky torso, no insect legs, no bird face, no extra wings or propellers. Slightly asymmetric blade angle in ready pose, visible opposing cutting edges, copper rotary coils and ivory ceramic bearings around the slender shaft. One tiny amber sensor on the front of the spindle; blackened steel blade faces with worn ochre accent stripes, polished bright shear edges, subtle oxidized copper and mineral fibers only near center. Original mining wire-cutting hardware becomes a precise living machine, not an ordinary bird or combat drone. Premium richly hand-painted stylized industrial-fantasy with elegant clean contours, deliberate shape hierarchy, readable broad painterly light and shadow and tactile restrained wear. Elevated three-quarter camera looking down 40 degrees; both full blades and center shaft entirely in frame with generous transparent margin, recognizable V silhouette at 70px. Solid object almost fully opaque on genuine transparent alpha. No projectile, blocking field, circular energy aura, scenery, floor, shadow, pedestal, text, logos, labels, UI, watermark or existing franchise design.

alpha_validation.notes: Original generated alpha preserved; broad subject is nearly opaque. Boundary has only trace low-alpha generation noise, not opaque clipping.

visual_inspection: Exactly two broad tapering shear blades surround the thin central spindle.
Readable open swallowtail V silhouette and rotary pivots.
No permanent projectile-blocking field baked into the sprite.
production_status: Single battle-ready illustration. Full directional animation, attacks, recovery and 70-pixel in-engine visual QA remain separate deliverables.
